messages.subject: 1.3 Changelog?
parts:
Looks like Shiny-Server v1.3.0 is now 'officially' out (via the website).
The NEWS file (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/master/NEWS) only highlights SUSE Linux support.
Is there a more comprehensive Changelog available anywhere (outside of sifting through diff-ed versions or github commit messages)?
(It helps just to research any of larger changes and if/where they might affect existing v1.2.3 installations.)

Cheers,

-murat
